visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dimly lit hallway. Two adults, a man and a woman in formal black suits and masks, stand as door attendants on either side of large, dark double doors. A glowing green exit sign is visible above the doors. The attendants place their hands on the door handles, ready to push. (2) The doors are swung open, revealing a bright, opulent ballroom interior with marble floors, a large crystal chandelier, and shimmering decorative columns. Two young boys walk through the doorway. One boy has bright red hair and stylized skull-like face paint, wearing a black pinstripe suit. He holds the hand of another boy in a matching pinstripe suit. (3) The two children walk down a carpeted aisle in the ballroom. The boy with the face paint waves his arm out as they walk. The room is filled with guests seated at round tables, some taking photos. The lighting is bright with cinematic spotlights. (4) A wide shot from behind shows the boys continuing down the aisle toward a large projection screen displaying a storybook castle. (5) The scene shifts to a brighter, more casual setting in the same doorway. A man in a white tank top and shorts is seen guiding three children: a boy, a toddler girl in a yellow Pikachu t-shirt, and the red-haired child now in a white oversized shirt. This appears to be a rehearsal. (6) The camera follows the toddler girl and the boy as they walk down the aisle during the rehearsal. They are holding hands. The red-haired child follows behind them, waving to imaginary guests. The ballroom is mostly empty of guests, but staff members are visible in the background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 3 main child characters, 3 adult guides/attendants, and a crowd of guests in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Three children: one boy with red hair and skull face paint in a pinstripe suit, another boy in a pinstripe suit, and a toddler girl in a yellow t-shirt and black shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury hotel ballroom with tall, reflective columns, crystal chandeliers, marble walls, and a large projection screen. The entrance area has heavy metal double doors and an exit sign.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with loud, high-energy crowd cheering and intense applause. Multiple voices are heard screaming in excitement. There is no music initially, just the raw acoustic environment of a large hall. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual of doors opening. The cheering volume peaks as the children enter. (3) A majestic, cinematic orchestral BGM starts playing, featuring strings and brass in a bright major key. The crowd continues to clap in a rhythmic manner. (4) The audio cuts to a different phase with a lighter, whimsical piano-driven melody. A female voice (off-screen) is heard clearly directing the children in Mandarin, using a very warm and encouraging tone. She tells them to walk in the middle and wave. The background atmosphere is much quieter than the previous phase, with lower crowd noise.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a charming moment from a 10th-anniversary wedding celebration, highlighting the children's grand entrance and contrasting it with behind-the-scenes rehearsal footage to show the preparation involved.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a contrast between a highly produced, dark-to-light 'grand entrance' and a bright, casual rehearsal to create a relatable and heartwarming narrative.
